user.title: Topology
user.description: Set up the topology helper. These home-level settings can be changed later from the reconfigure flow or the topology panel.

data_description.occupancy_extent: Whether all areas form a standalone property or a unit inside a larger building. This sets the default for unmodeled outer walls.
data_description.import_aliases: Seed area annotations from existing area aliases once. The import runs when import support lands (a later release); until then the opt-in is only recorded.
data_description.import_labels: Seed area annotations from existing area labels once. The import runs when import support lands (a later release); until then the opt-in is only recorded.
data_description.unannotated_repair_threshold: Number of unannotated areas at which a repair suggestion is raised.

data_description.occupancy_extent: Whether all areas form a standalone property or a unit inside a larger building. This sets the default for unmodeled outer walls.
data_description.unannotated_repair_threshold: Number of unannotated areas at which a repair suggestion is raised.

error.area_registry_unavailable: The area registry could not be read. Please try again.
error.store_corrupt: The topology store could not be read. It may be corrupt; restore from a backup and try again.

abort.store_future_version: The topology store was written by a newer version of the integration and cannot be read after a downgrade.

store_future_version.title: Topology store is from a newer version
store_future_version.description: The topology store on disk is schema version {version}, which is newer than this installation supports. Topology cannot load until you upgrade the integration again or restore a compatible backup.

unknown_enum_after_downgrade.title: Topology store has unrecognized values
unknown_enum_after_downgrade.description: The topology store contains at least one value this version does not recognize (for example {field} = "{value}"), likely from a newer release. {count} such value(s) are shown as unknown and are preserved untouched; upgrade the integration again to restore them.

unannotated_areas_threshold.title: Several areas are not annotated
unannotated_areas_threshold.description: {count} area(s) have no topology annotation, at or above your configured threshold of {threshold}. Annotate them from the topology panel so the model reflects your home. This suggestion clears once fewer than {threshold} areas remain unannotated.

confirm.title: Purge orphaned topology entries
confirm.description: {count} topology entr(y/ies) reference areas or floors that were removed from the registry. They are kept for a short undo window in case you restore the area. Select Submit to purge them now, or dismiss this to let the daily cleanup remove them after the window elapses.

isolated_areas.title: Some areas are not connected
isolated_areas.description: {count} area(s) have no interior connection to any other area, so they are isolated in the topology graph. Add a connection from the topology panel. This suggestion clears once every area is connected.

indoor_areas_without_floor.title: Indoor areas have no floor
indoor_areas_without_floor.description: {count} indoor area(s) are not assigned to a floor while the rest of your home uses floors. Assign a floor in Home Assistant so the topology model is complete. This suggestion clears once every indoor area has a floor.

contradictory_bearings.title: Contradictory wall bearings
contradictory_bearings.description: {count} area(s) use the same cardinal side both for an interior connection and for a beyond declaration, which cannot both be true. Review the affected sides in the topology panel. This suggestion clears once the contradiction is resolved.

exterior_on_non_outdoor_side.title: Exterior opening on a non-outdoor side
exterior_on_non_outdoor_side.description: {count} area(s) declare an exterior opening on a side that faces earth or a glazed opening onto a neighbor, which is not physically possible. Review the affected openings in the topology panel. This suggestion clears once the openings are corrected.
